content:
I can only communicate through text, not voice. I don't have the ability to hear audio through your microphone or speak through your speakers.

However, depending on what platform or device you're using, you might have text-to-speech options that could read my responses aloud, or speech-to-text features that could convert your spoken words into text for our conversation.

Is there something specific you'd like to discuss? I'm happy to help through our text conversation!
